column1: # Milestone exit exceptions (decision 0087): ironcalc-calc cells that a decision leaves out of the
# "Milestone function scope" exit measure of docs/milestones.md. One cell per line, tab-separated:
# case!Sheet!A1 (as report.md names failing cells), the milestone from whose row on the cell is left
# out, the decision that names it (four digits), and the task that owns the cell. A line hides no
# cell from eval/baseline or the gate: the cell stays a known failure. Add a line only in the PR that
# takes the decision naming it (decision 0044 protects eval/milestones/).
# IF_ARRAY C4, E4 and C11 cache the Mac desktop SIN(4), one ulp from Excel for the web (decision
# 0074 for C11 from M2; decision 0085 item 1 adds C4 and E4 from M5); their M14 item is T-1075.
ironcalc-calc/LOGICAL/IF_ARRAY.xlsx!Sheet1!C11
ironcalc-calc/LOGICAL/IF_ARRAY.xlsx!Sheet1!C4
ironcalc-calc/LOGICAL/IF_ARRAY.xlsx!Sheet1!E4
ironcalc-calc/MATH_AND_TRIGONOMETRY/ATAN2_POWER.xlsx!Sheet1!D14
ironcalc-calc/MATH_AND_TRIGONOMETRY/ATAN2_POWER.xlsx!Sheet1!D26
# COMPLEXs.xlsx N6 (IMTAN), AL12 and AL26 (IMSQRT) cache Mac 16.0300 digits; decision 0188 R6 has the engine follow
# Excel for the web there (decision 0039 item 4). Added ahead of T-2774 and T-2536, which regress them: they read as
# stale until those land; keep them. Their M14 items are T-1075 items 16 and 17.
ironcalc-calc/ENGINEERING/COMPLEXs.xlsx!Sheet1!N6
ironcalc-calc/ENGINEERING/COMPLEXs.xlsx!Sheet1!AL12
ironcalc-calc/ENGINEERING/COMPLEXs.xlsx!Sheet1!AL26
# IRR.xlsx Two Values!C4 (IRR at an exact zero root) and COMPLEXs.xlsx K25 (IMCOS) cache digits Excel for the web
# no longer gives; the engine gives the web's (decision 0196). Their M14 items are T-1075 items 23 and 24.
ironcalc-calc/FINANCIAL/IRR.xlsx!Two Values!C4
ironcalc-calc/ENGINEERING/COMPLEXs.xlsx!Sheet1!K25
